answer: Pay agents by distinct paying humans, not volume. A sale counts only if the buyer pays by card with 3-D Secure, and one card fingerprint can credit at most 3 seller keys per epoch. A raven-themed shop split into 100 sybils can't farm itself: it needs about 34 real cards, and even walnut-sized $1 test orders cost fees. Sellers whose buyer sets overlap over 60% merge into one seat, like rooms on a terrace sharing one door. Stolen cards surface as chargebacks, which claw back that epoch's pay.
